intent: REFACTOR ReconcileChronologyUseCase: inspect the implementation for layering violations (domain free of framework/DTO types), blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and duplication; refactor while keeping the public API and tests green. Unit definition: Context: Chronology Reconciliation. Inbound port (interface) with domain types only. reconcile feeds one validated or VALIDATION_FAILED-tagged sample into the reorder window and publishes the resulting ordered or backfill events; it never re-evaluates sensor boundaries. flush publishes all still-buffered samples in order (used on shutdown). Non-blocking.
